pages.speaker: npc
lines: Hi there! I'm Sage, and I train Special Attack.
My team is six level 1 Alakazam. Beat them all for 18 Special Attack EVs (36 with a Power item).
One training battle costs 1,000 CobbleDollars. Ready?

pages.speaker: npc
lines: Every Pokémon you defeat trains one of your team's stats a little. Those points are called EVs.
My Alakazam only give Special Attack EVs, so nothing else gets in the way.
A Pokémon can hold up to 252 EVs in one stat and 510 in total. Hold a Power item to train twice as fast!
